simplytents.config.title: SimplyTents Settings
When you sneak and right-click a tent with an empty hand, also pack the blocks and entities placed inside it.
simplytents.config.restrictPickup.desc: Only the player who originally placed a tent can pack it back up.
simplytents.config.spawnLogic.desc: What happens to your spawn point when you pack a tent that contains your bed.

simplytents.config.maxContainers.desc: How many chests, barrels and other containers may be placed inside one tent. Unlimited by default; None blocks them entirely.
simplytents.config.allowTentsInContainer: When off, tents cannot be stored in bundles or shulker boxes, and packing a tent will drop any tents held by containers inside it instead of nesting them.
simplytents.config.heavyThreshold.desc: Carrying more than this many tents applies Slowness, imitating heavy gear. Off disables the effect.
simplytents.config.tentTransparent.desc: Whether the tent counts as a transparent block. Turn this OFF so shelter-detecting mods (e.g. Vampirism sun damage) treat the tent interior as indoors. It works by stopping skylight, which also darkens the inside. Reload the world after changing.
message.simplytents.no_containers_in_ten: Containers cannot be placed inside tents.
message.simplytents.container_limit: This tent already holds the maximum of %s containers.
tooltip.simplytents.tent_lock: Right-click a tent to lock it. Use /simplytents trust <player> to let others in.
message.simplytents.lock_not_owner: This tent belongs to someone else.
message.simplytents.trust_players_only: This command must be run by a player.
message.simplytents.trust_no_tent: Look at a tent to use this command.
message.simplytents.trust_not_owner: You do not own this tent.
message.simplytents.trust_removed: %s can no longer use this tent.
message.simplytents.trust_already: %s is already trusted on this tent.
message.simplytents.trust_missing: %s is not trusted on this tent.
message.simplytents.trust_list_empty: No players are trusted on this tent.
simplytents.config.mobsIgnoreTentedPlaye: Hostile mobs cannot target a player inside a tent. Mobs you have already attacked keep hunting you, so a tent is cover rather than immunity.
simplytents.config.capturedEntities.desc: Which entities travel with a tent when you pack it. Players are never packed, and neither is a mob a player is riding.
